title: The End of a ShieldCare Coverage Term
content:
A Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan expires at the end of its coverage end day, and cover
left unused is written off rather than refunded.

A claim whose incident day falls on or before the coverage end day is paid after expiry, provided
it was reported inside the claim report window, and the plan is worked to a decision even though
it has expired.

An expired plan is not renewed in place. A fresh plan may be sold only where the item still meets
the admission rules, and the item's age is counted from its original purchase day.

A plan whose term is cut short by cancellation or by termination for non-payment does not expire
as well: the earlier ending stands and only one ending is recorded.

The coverage end day is not moved because the item was away for repair, and no credit is given
for days the item could not be used.

### The rule at the boundary

| Fact recorded | The rule's answer |
| --- | --- |
| Incident on the coverage end day, reported inside the report window | Paid after expiry, and the claim is worked to a decision |
| Incident on the day after the coverage end day | Outside the term |
| Incident inside the term, reported after the report window had run | Not inside the report window, whatever the expiry position |
| Plan cancelled two months before its end day | The cancellation is the one ending recorded; no expiry is recorded as well |
| Item away at the depot for three weeks | The end day does not move and no credit is given for those days |
| Term run out, item still admissible | A fresh plan may be sold, with the item's age counted from its original purchase day |
